name: opentrace
description:
Answer architecture and code-structure questions from your organization's indexed code graphs, across every repository OpenTrace has indexed — not just the checkout you have open.

OpenTrace indexes your repositories into code graphs and serves them over a hosted MCP server. This plugin connects Claude Code to it and gives the model the context to use it well:

- 19 read-only tools: search a graph for symbols, files and dependencies; explore the neighborhood around one symbol; read bounded source text; and query pull requests and issues alongside the code.
- Cross-repository reach. One search covers an entire indexed snapshot, so "who calls this", "does this exist", and "how does this subsystem fit together" get bounded answers — including definitive negatives — instead of a series of greps.
- Session prewarm. At session start the plugin resolves your checkout to its indexed source, and reports how far the index sits behind your HEAD, so the first tool call needs no discovery hops and stale answers are labelled as stale.

Authentication is the standard MCP OAuth flow: run /mcp and sign in on first use. An OpenTrace account with at least one indexed repository is required.

mcp_url.title: OpenTrace MCP endpoint
mcp_url.description: OpenTrace MCP endpoint URL. Must end in /mcp/v1, with no trailing slash — the server advertises the no-slash form as its OAuth resource identifier, and a mismatch fails the sign-in. Leave as the default unless you are pointing at a different OpenTrace host.
